title: Button
description: Interactive button UI element for triggering actions.
content:
Button

Interactive button UI element that executes commands when activated by the player.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"button": {
  "text": "...",
  "onClick": []
}

Description

The Button component provides an interactive clickable UI element. It displays a text label and executes a list of commands when activated by the player through clicking or pressing. Buttons support hover and pressed visual states and are commonly used in menus, dialog prompts, and in-game interfaces.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
textstringThe display label shown on the button.
onClickstring[]Array of commands to execute when the button is activated.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "button": {
      "text": "Start Game",
      "onClick": ["loadScene main_level", "playSound ui_confirm"]
    }
  }
}
